sourceText:
Xocai Healthy Chocolate Trail Mix
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Thursday, October 27, 2011 - 9:03pm

Ingredients




6 oz 	slivered almond
1/2 cup 	pumpkin seeds ((shelled))
1/2 cup 	walnuts
1/2 cup 	shredded coconut ((sweetened))
1/2 cup 	dried cranberries
1/2 cup 	dried apricot
1/2 cup 	dark chocolate,  ("Xocai Healthy Chocolate XoBiotic Squares" (chopped))

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. On a foil-lined baking sheet, combine almonds, pumpkin seeds, walnuts, and coconut. Bake in oven for 10 minutes or until coconut is golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool. Combine toasted coconut mixture with dried cranberries, apricots, and "Xocai XoBiotic Squares." Serves 8

Comments:
Pol vanRhee

This is a great place to use the Xocai Sipping chocolate. The tiny morsels are perfect for trail mix
